summary: Every finding from the last round is fixed and tested. Remaining: an untested AggregateError branch, an outdated architecture-doc Errors section, and a PR description with no compatibility matrix.

comments.body: **Minor.** When two or more failed `closePositions` results carry an attached cause, they are wrapped in `new AggregateError(reportedCauses, 'closePositions per-position failures')`. That branch has no test. The new test in `TradingService.test.ts` ('logs the attached cause of a mixed batch close…') covers only the single-cause path (`logged.cause` is `normalized`), and no test in the package mentions `AggregateError`. Close-all with several failures (for example, every position refused for the same venue reason) is the usual way to reach this branch, so the Sentry payload for it is unverified. Ask: add a case with two failed results, each with its own attached cause, and assert `logged.cause` is an `AggregateError` whose `errors` are those two normalized errors in result order. Also assert that a failed result with no attached cause is left out of `errors`.
